label: Bible Study
prompt: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a _____: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
verse: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
note: John doesn't mince words — loving God while hating your brother doesn't add up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be _____, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
verse: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
note: Everything else may shake, but believers receive a kingdom which cannot be moved.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side _____.
verse: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
note: Blind Bartimaeus sat begging by the Jericho roadside — and he was about to make a lot of noise.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD, which hath not left thee this day without a _____, that his name may be famous in Israel.
verse: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD, which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.
note: The kinsman-redeemer was the relative who bought back family land — Boaz did, and Naomi got a grandson.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Seest thou a man _____ in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
verse: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
note: See a man 'diligent' in his business? He'll stand before kings — Joseph and Daniel could testify.
